name: Shenzhen Yitoa Intelligent Control Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Yitoa Intelligent Control Co.,Ltd. provides intelligent control products for appliances in China and internationally. The company provides semiconductor products, such as display driver chips, power devices, MEMS micromirrors, and photoelectric sensors; and optoelectronic integrated circuits, optical sensors, and automotive ICs. It also provides electronic components, including passive components, memory devices, touch displays, semiconductors, modules, and electronic materials. Shenzhen Yitoa Intelligent Control Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
